title: A locally injective map into a sheaf induces an injective map on the sheafification
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] on which presheaves of abelian groups have sheafifications, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of rings on $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules with sheafification $\eta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f:\mathcal P\to\mathcal F$ a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules and $f^\#:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal F$ the unique morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules with $f^\#\circ\eta=f$. Suppose $f$ is *locally injective*: for every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$ and every $x\in\mathcal P(V)$ with $f_V(x)=0$ there is a covering $\{V_k\to V\}_k$ of $\mathcal C$ such that $x|_{V_k}=0$ in $\mathcal P(V_k)$ for every $k$. Then $f^\#_W:\mathcal P^\#(W)\to\mathcal F(W)$ is injective for every object $W$ of $\mathcal C$; in particular $f^\#$ is a monomorphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules.

source.place: Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus) and Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification), with Section 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures) and literature/stacks-project/sites-modules.tex Lemma 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules); used in this form in the proof of etale-cohomology.tex Lemma 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale)

proof.text: Let $t\in\mathcal P^\#(W)$ satisfy $f^\#_W(t)=0$. By the local-sections description of sheafification [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local], there is a covering $\{W_i\to W\}_i$ and sections $x_i\in\mathcal P(W_i)$ with $t|_{W_i}=\eta_{W_i}(x_i)$. The equality $f^\#\circ\eta=f$ and restriction functoriality give $f_{W_i}(x_i)=f^\#_{W_i}(t|_{W_i})=(f^\#_W(t))|_{W_i}=0$.

source.place: Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification), first paragraph, together with the defining equation for the sheafification lift in Modules on Sites, Lemma 03CY

proof.text: For each $i$, local injectivity of $f$ applied to $x_i$ supplies a covering $\{W_{ij}\to W_i\}_j$ on which every restriction of $x_i$ is zero. Pulling these coverings back along $W_i\to W$ and composing with $\{W_i\to W\}_i$ gives a covering of $W$ by the site axioms [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. On every member $W_{ij}$, the restriction of $t$ is the restriction of $\eta(x_i)=t|_{W_i}$ and is therefore $\eta(0)=0$.

source.place: Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification), local-refinement argument, and Modules on Sites, Lemma 03CY

proof.text: The underlying sheaf of sets of the module sheafification is the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of sets [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheafification-underlying-sets]. Thus the zero restrictions in the preceding step are equalities in the underlying sheaf of sets, not merely in a module presentation; the same conclusion also follows directly from the underlying map of the module sheafification unit.

source.place: Lemma 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), with Sites Section 00YR and Sheaves Lemma 0087(1)

proof.text: Since $\mathcal P^\#$ is a sheaf, its underlying presheaf of sets is separated: a section whose restrictions to a covering are all zero is itself zero by the equalizer sheaf condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, part (1)]. Hence $t=0$. This proves that every section map $f^\#_W$ is injective. A morphism of sheaves of modules is a monomorphism exactly when all its section maps are injective, so $f^\#$ is a monomorphism.
